items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: it's a Spanish number written by some woman by the name of Dana might have been published in Mexico or someplace first I'm not sure

ctx.x: it's a Spanish number written by some woman by the name of Dana might have been published in Mexico or someplace first I'm not sure well anyway it's Flea is a Bird F-L-E-E and somehow the printer didn't see the L and got it free as a Bird it came out that way so I saw it in the I didn't see some of the prints some of the proofs galley proofs and I think I might have even seen that in time to mention it to Ramsey but it cost fifty cents to change each word after it was set up and that was the still the depression…
